headline: Front-End Engineer
summary: Front-End Engineer, 7+ years in Angular and TypeScript, most of it in FinTech and Web3, on screens dense with tables and charting where a wrong number is noticed in seconds. Comfortable turning a complicated business into features with product design and stakeholders, and drawn to the R&D and AI end of a product, where the shape of the interface is still open.
availability: Based in Istanbul, available for remote work.
availabilityRelocation: Based in Istanbul, open to relocating to {place}.

remorch: Took ownership of a secure PWA end to end and shipped it, from architecture through to deployment.
Built a modular Angular component library and the design system every DeFi feature was assembled from.
Integrated REST APIs into secure workflows for digital assets, with the real-time updates the trading desk needs.
Deployed a mobile-first, search-optimized platform and drove the performance optimization work that followed.
Presented the product at the company's Web Summit booth as the technical person answering investors.
dara: Delivered an order management system with a cross-functional Agile team, pair programming daily with the desk.
Built real-time trading views on AgGrid, Highcharts and TradingView, with live data and no page refresh.
Integrated SignalR WebSockets to carry high-frequency data to more than 5,000 active traders.
Mentored new joiners onto the stack and the brokerage business, and ran knowledge-sharing sessions.
mymonshi: Built a B2B CRM platform end to end, from design mockups through to production audio and video calling.
Led the R&D that chose the core stack, reworked the state store, and built secure cloud storage and real-time chat.
rampart: Ran requirements analysis with stakeholders and turned mockups into implementation plans the team could estimate.
Raised code quality across inherited projects, and developed virtual tours for architectural projects.
